name: Error-based Densification
definition: A densification strategy that steers growing decisions based on an auxiliary per-pixel error function Eπ (e.g., Structural Similarity) rather than positional gradient magnitude, solving the issue where gradient-based methods are blind to absolute error values in high-frequency areas.
summary: Error-based Densification grows Gaussian primitives by redistributing per-pixel rendering errors proportional to their contribution, unlike gradient-based methods that ignore absolute error values.
